heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 116–283, div. G, title LVXXXV [LXXXV], § 8512(a)(2), Jan. 1, 2021, 134 Stat. 4759

notes.text: Section, R.S. § 4661, related to necessity for cession by State of jurisdiction for building of lighthouses and other sites.
